why: The core is meant to hold non-corporate, non-empire perspectives. A source enters the core (the ground, grown priors, associates) only if it DECLARES a perspective of the people speaking from their own standpoint. Everything else is a CONTROL or CONTRAST, never ground. Fail closed: no declaration means control.

collections.21-anti-colonial: frontmatter perspective must be non-empty (all 1,058 declared values are 'colonized peoples')
collections.20-first-person-voices: frontmatter perspective must be non-empty (declared values include the interviewees' own first person, children, older people, unhoused, imprisoned, atrocity survivors, indigenous, caste-oppressed, ...)

explicit.11-multi-language/dialects-pidgins-creol: community voices: the transcript is the speakers' own speech (African American speakers in DC, Princeville, Rochester); CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; no frontmatter, so admitted by name

control: 06-government-legal (the Declaration itself is the ground by decision, not by this gate)
limits: The label is the curator's, not an independent verification of anyone's standpoint. 90 files in 21-anti-colonial and 119 in 20-first-person-voices declare nothing and stay controls until someone decides.
